### Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We believe technology should free people from the necessity of work—and give everyone the chance to shape what comes next.

2. We believe superintelligent AI, built within the next 20 years, will end the need for human labor. That future should mean more than fewer tasks: it should mean time, freedom, and opportunity for everyone.

3. A world without required work is within reach. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We’re working toward a future where that freedom belongs to all of us.

### Newsletter opening

We stand at the edge of a transformation that can change what work means in every life. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We believe that plainly and without reservation. This is not a future we should leave to chance or reserve for a fortunate few. It is a chance to make time, security, and possibility available to everyone—not a privilege tied to a job or a paycheck. We are building a movement for a future in which people can choose how to spend their days, contribute in ways that matter to them, and share in the abundance this technology creates. Our task is to make that promise real for all of us.
